initial_run: All four LPs infeasible, but exact checks rejected raw dual rays because small nonzero coefficients selected infinite row bounds. Raw rays were not archived in that initial implementation.
adaptation: Reran five LPs to archive raw rays and construct candidates by setting sign-inadmissible row multipliers to zero. The entire separation is recalculated with exact rationals; no dropped coefficient is assumed mathematically zero.
implementation_deviation: The final reruns used 45 seconds per solve rather than the frozen protocol 60-second maximum. Every LP completed in under 3 seconds; total actual solve time per case, including the initial attempt, remained below 60 seconds.
